stages.title: AI-assisted research synthesis
steps: Collect raw inputs (interviews, tickets, field notes) into one corpus.
Run AI summarization only with a human review gate before anything is shared.
Export a stakeholder-ready theme map linked to open bets.
useCases: Interview transcript indexing and theme surfacing
Stakeholder map drafts — moderator approves before workshop
Research stimulus for moderated tests on production-aligned UI

stages.title: Decision teardown
stages.meta: Bet memo, kill date, reversal cost
steps: Frame one high-stakes decision with product and eng in the room.
Write the bet, kill criterion, and reversal cost in plain language.
Log the call in an append-only decision record the team can revisit.

stages.title: AI workflow in production pilots
stages.meta: HITL map, override paths, RN handoff
steps: Map the on-truck or in-field journey where AI suggests the next action.
Define live, partial, and offline states with override on every suggestion.
Hand off RN-ready specs only after pilot technicians validate flows.
useCases: Diagnosis-to-parts assist with a defensible next action
Next-best-action cards with override and audit trail for dispatch
Offline-safe AI states so technicians are never blocked mid-visit

stages.title: Outcomes proof loop
steps: Name one decision latency signal per programme (what got faster, not vanity metrics).
Track override and exception rates inside agreed guardrails.
Close the loop in a written measure memo tied to the original bet.
